import pandas as pd
import multiprocessing
import time

def test():
    data = {"a": [1, 2, 4], "b": [4, 5, 6]}
    df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(data)

    df[df["a"] == 1]["b"] = 5
    assert df[df["a"] == 1]["b"].item() == 5, "Value not changed"

    # Disable warning
    pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None

    # Modify code to avoid SettingWithCopyWarning
    df = df[df["a"] == 1]
    df["b"] = 5
    assert df["b"].item() == 5, "Value not changed"

    # Start multiple processes to append to a list
    list = []
    for i in range(500):
        p = multiprocessing.Process(target=lambda: list.append(i))
        p.start()

    # Wait for all processes to finish
    for p in multiprocessing.active_children():
        p.join()

    # Check if all processes have finished
    for p in multiprocessing.active_children():
        p.join()

    assert len(list) == 500, "List not filled with values"
